items.title: watchOS 27.3 Brings Live Rewind and Siri Recap to Apple Watch
items.excerpt: With the first beta of watchOS 27.3, Apple is introducing new Audio Intelligence features it previewed for the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 earlier this year. Powered by the S11 chip, Audio Intelligence includes Live Rewind, Siri Recap, Sound Recognition, and Shazam Music Recognition. Sound Recognition and Shazam are already on the watch, but Live Rewind and Siri Recap are now available in the beta. Live Rewind can show you a transcript of the last 15 seconds of a conversation.
items.rationale: New watchOS 27.3 beta release puts on-wrist conversation transcription and recap in users' hands; most detailed of the three c0 cluster articles.

items.title: Apple starts giving Siri AI access to third-party apps
items.excerpt: Siri AI is also expanding across Calendar, Mail, Messages, Music, and more.
items.rationale: Siri AI opening to third-party apps is a platform-level change for every iPhone app maker; distinct feature from the Watch story and from the iOS 27.2 card of 10-27.

items.title: Sonos' new voice assistant is launching in early access on November 6
items.excerpt: The company is hoping to collect feedback on Sonos 27voice to avoid a repeat of its previous app redesign debacle.
items.rationale: Dated early-access launch of Sonos's own AI voice assistant; chose Engadget over The Verge (c8) to keep outlet spread.

items.title: Cyclon wants to replace your iPhone with an AI phone that actually gets things done
items.excerpt: Y Combinator-backed startup Cyclon is building an AI phone that can navigate apps, complete tasks, and even create apps on demand.
items.rationale: New agentic AI-phone hardware/software product; Digital Trends version is the more substantive of the two Cyclon articles.

items.title: ChatGPT Dots are getting smarter, and you won't have to lift a finger
items.excerpt: OpenAI is making ChatGPT Dots smarter with GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Terra, allowing them to automatically pick the best AI model for each task.
items.rationale: Replaces the LG/SoundHound TV-ordering pick (little AI substance): a concrete new model update (GPT-6 Astra / GPT-6.1 Terra with automatic model routing) for ChatGPT Dots, from a fifth distinct outlet.

https://www.androidauthority.com/openai-.new_action: New model release for Dots: GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Terra roll out with automatic per-task model selection (the 10-29 card covered texting the Dot agent, a different feature).
